examples.english: In Japan, the custom is to wash your body with the shower before soaking in the bathtub.

notes:
シャワー (from English "shower") refers to both the shower fixture and the act of showering. In Japan, showers are often part of the bathing area (⟦{浴室|よくしつ}→浴室：05301_yokushitsu⟧) and used before soaking in the bathtub.

Common expressions:
- シャワー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧ (take a shower)
- シャワー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (turn on the shower)
- シャワー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧ (turn off the shower)
- ⟦シャワールーム→シャワールーム：28523_shawaaruumu⟧ (shower room)

Cultural note:
In Japanese bathing culture, the shower is typically used to wash the body before entering the ⟦{浴槽|よくそう}→浴槽：04985_yokusou⟧ (bathtub) for soaking. Taking a quick "shower only" without a bath is more of a Western practice.
